Frequently Asked Questions

What happens after I pay? How do I actually receive my items?
▾

Once your payment goes through, there's a short manual step on our end before delivery starts.

Right after checking out, send us your Roblox username through the order form or the Log-in/Claim Order option in the header. That username is the only thing we need from you — we'll never ask for your password.

From there, we reach out to you directly in-game to complete the handoff. Most orders are completed within 5–15 minutes of us receiving your username, though this can shift slightly depending on Roblox's own trade cooldowns or availability on our end.

My order hasn't arrived — what do I do?
▾

First, don't panic — delivery delays usually come down to something simple, like a Roblox trade cooldown or us needing to double check your username.

Message support with your order number, your Roblox username, and a short description of what's going on. Screenshots help us sort it out faster if you have any.

It might take a little while to get back to you. We'll either finish the delivery or figure out what went wrong together.

Is Buylance safe to buy from?
▾

We built the checkout flow specifically to avoid asking for anything sensitive — the only thing we ever need to deliver your order is your Roblox username.

Payments themselves are handled by trusted third-party providers (like PayPal), so your card or account details are never something we see or store directly.

We'll never ask for your password, and we'll never ask you to download anything to "claim" an order — if anyone claiming to be from Buylance asks for either of those, it's not really us.

Can I get a refund?
▾

Once an item or currency pack has been delivered to your account, it's considered final — digital goods can't really be "returned" the way a physical item can.

That said, if something went wrong on our end — wrong item delivered, or an order that never showed up despite you doing everything right — we'll make it right, either by redelivering or refunding.

Full details live on our Refund Policy page, including what happens if you don't respond to delivery instructions within 14 days.

More About Buylance

🏬

So what exactly is Buylance, anyway?

Buylance is a small, Filipino-run marketplace for Roblox in-game items and currency. We focus on a handful of games at a time — right now Blade Ball tokens and PS99 gems — so every order gets delivered by hand, quickly and correctly, instead of spreading thin across dozens of titles.

🛍️

Which items and games are actually available right now?

  • Blade Ball — in-game tokens for gear and upgrades
  • PS99 (Pet Simulator 99) — Gems, from starter packs up to whale-sized bundles

More games get added as the shop grows — tell us what you're after using the form above.

%

What makes buying here different from other sellers?

Straightforward pricing with no hidden markups, hand-delivered orders, attentive support, and small perks like cashback and spin draws for regular buyers.

🛡️

Should I actually trust this site with my info?

We only ever need your Roblox username to complete a delivery — never your password, and never a download. Payments go through trusted providers, so your card or account details stay with them, not us.

⚡

Once I've paid, what does getting my order actually look like?

After checkout, send your Roblox username through the order form. We reach out in-game and hand off the item or currency directly, typically within 5–15 minutes.

💬

Something's wrong with my order — now what?

Message support with your order details — it might take a little while, but we'll get back to you.
